description: How the items of a block (social, navbar, carousel, accordion) are edited (§3.9). Inline is the default and keeps every field in the inspector; Dialog shows a compact list whose Edit action opens a modal editor over a copy of the item, so the document changes in one action and one undo step.

members.name: Inline
members.description: Every field of every item is rendered inline in the inspector (default, the 2.9.x behaviour).

members.name: Dialog
members.description: A compact list (preview + edit / remove / move) with a modal editor over a copy of the item.
